data.final_week_advice: Focus on timed practice and reviewing weak areas from Unit 2 and Unit 5.
data.summary: This 3-week plan prioritizes Unit 2 (weak unit) in Week 1 with a live class, covers Units 1, 3, and 4 in Week 2, and dedicates Week 3 to mixed review and timed practice. The plan ensures all units are touched upon while respecting the 7-hour weekly limit.

weeks.focus: Master Newton's Laws and Free-Body Diagrams
tasks: Do 10 free-response questions on Newton's Second Law, then mark them against the scoring guide
Create free-body diagrams for 5 complex systems involving friction and tension
Solve 5 kinematics problems involving vectors in 2D (1.5)
Calculate work and energy for 3 scenarios involving potential energy (3.2, 3.3)
Analyze 2 collision problems using conservation of momentum (4.3)
Complete a 90-minute timed practice exam covering Units 1-4
Review rotational dynamics concepts (5.1-5.4) and solve 3 torque problems
Practice SHM and Fluids problems (7.1, 8.2) to ensure broad coverage
